notes: «قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» and «- واللفظ له -» are the compiler's notes on the reading and are left out.
«ابنى محمد بن علي» describes the two sons by their father; the surfaces are the sons' names, and «أبيهما» is the father, named only by relation.
Ali is the last link: the Prophet's ban is reported in his words.
